PLAN "12-Week Moderate-Intensity General Fitness (Post-MI Safe)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "improve general fitness safely post-MI"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation and Technique" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Full Body A":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8..10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 2x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x20..30 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          walking 8m rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 1m
          hamstring_stretch 1m
          shoulder_stretch 1m
          calf_stretch 1m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Full Body B":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 3x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x8..10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 2x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8..10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          walking 8m rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 1m
          back_stretch 1m
          tricep_stretch 1m
          calf_stretch 1m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full Body C":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 3x8 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x8..10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          walking 8m rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 1m
          spinal_twist 1m
          quad_stretch 1m
          shoulder_stretch 1m
